title: Brazil Star Neymar Announces International Retirement: 'It Is Now Over'
facts: Neymar announced his retirement from international football after Brazil's 2-1 loss to Norway in the World Cup round of 16.
Neymar concludes his international career as the top goalscorer in the history of the Brazilian men's national team.
Neymar scored 80 goals in 129 appearances for the Brazilian men's national team.
Neymar made his senior international debut for the Brazilian national team in 2010.
Neymar participated in four separate World Cup tournaments during his career.
Neymar competed in two Olympic tournaments representing Brazil.
Neymar won a silver medal with the Brazilian team at the 2012 Olympic tournament.
Neymar led the Brazilian national team to a gold medal at the 2016 Olympics.
Neymar made exactly two substitute appearances for Brazil during the 2026 World Cup.
Neymar scored his only goal of the 2026 World Cup from a penalty kick against Norway in stoppage time.
Neymar made a second-half cameo appearance against Scotland during the 2026 World Cup group stage.
Thierry Henry praised Neymar's overall career on the FOX Sports program 'World Cup Today'.
Zlatan Ibrahimović publicly commended Neymar's football career and skill set following the retirement announcement.
Zlatan Ibrahimović noted that people wanted Neymar to win the Ballon d'Or but he did not achieve the award.
Norway advanced to the 2026 World Cup quarterfinals to play the winner of the match between Mexico and England.
